exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Complex time expressions — by the time, no sooner had

items.prompt: By the time the board ___, three workstreams had already fallen behind.
No sooner ___ we agreed the scope ___ it began to change.
items.hintAfterError: 'No sooner' pede inversão com o auxiliar do past perfect, e a segunda parte começa com a palavra de comparação.

items.prompt: By the time anyone ___ the issue, two months had passed.
No sooner ___ the budget ___ approved than the first change request arrived.
By the time the programme ___ its second year, the original timeline was irrelevant.
